report_name: Common-Sense Cloud Security Act Introduced in U.S. Congress

identities.name: Rich McCormick
identities.description: U.S. Representative who introduced the 'Common-Sense Cloud Security Act' on October 29, 2026.

identities.name: National Institute of Standards and Technology
identities.description: U.S. agency directed by the 'Common-Sense Cloud Security Act' to lead the development of modernized cybersecurity standards for cloud computing environments.

identities.name: Cloud Service Providers
identities.description: A class of organizations that would need to align their services with new NIST standards if the 'Common-Sense Cloud Security Act' is passed.

identities.name: U.S. Federal Government Agencies
identities.description: A class of organizations whose adoption of cloud services is governed by the Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP), which would be updated under the proposed legislation.

identities.name: Critical Infrastructure Operators
identities.description: A class of organizations that rely on cloud services and would be guided by the new standards proposed in the 'Common-Sense Cloud Security Act'.
